visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, chestnut-brown hair wearing a black-and-white horizontally striped sweater and carrying a black backpack sits at a bright yellow table. Beside her, a young girl with dark hair and a purple sweater watches intently. They are located inside a lottery shop filled with vibrant red posters and promotional flyers. (2) The camera zooms in on the yellow table surface where multiple pink lottery scratch-off cards are spread out. The woman and the child use silver coins to vigorously scratch the protective layer off the tickets, revealing various numbers and symbols. A laptop and some decorative items sit in the background. (3) The scene transitions to a different corner of the shop where the woman stands in front of a lottery display counter. She is holding several tickets and a pink pamphlet. Behind her, a lottery machine with a digital screen is visible, surrounded by numerous lottery-related signage and a small decorative tree. (4) A close-up view of the woman holding a pink lottery ticket toward the camera while smiling broadly. She is standing in the same shop environment, with more lottery posters visible in the blurred background. Her expression is joyful and energetic as she presents the results. (5) The final shot shows the woman smiling at the camera and making a peace sign with her hand. She continues to hold the lottery materials. The bright indoor lighting emphasizes the cheerful atmosphere of the shop, which is packed with traditional red and yellow lottery advertisements.
